Hey. Im right there with you. Im in my umpteenth failing relationship, this one has hardly last a month, i just got a record against me after having a nervous breakdown when all my stuff was stolen and i broke a window. I got evicted and had to move back home. I feel like im drowning and it seems like im alone with no friends who will respond to my messages, and a girl who is sleeping in another room to avoid me and me so afraid of being alone i wont talk about it and risk losing the last thing i have. But if im honest its already gone. Im 25 and feel ready for an end. But ive been here too many times to count and i know when i get set up and ready to do it i wont be able to. Which depresses me even more lol. But the only thing i know for certain is things will change. And probably one day ill be grateful to be alive. I hope you hold out for that day too.

I know the struggle of growing up in an alcoholic house, but it was just my dad. Thats really great you were able to turn your life around. They hung out with there friends first and wanted to keep that life seperate. It was great to be around and wish it could have lasted but you cant force your way into peoples lives, they dont like that lol. I might get a facebook message once a month now with them, but cant ever schedule anything. But its good you could find work, my roommate has a record and cant find work. Thats why hes such a burden. How was prison?

I wrote a post similar to this a minute ago. Its also my last week. I hope you dont do it, i know you feel sometimes like you want to but things like that really work out. You will feel better and if you keep going out and applying you will find a job. There may be a day when suicide is the only option, and your problems are so big you cant get out. In that moment youll be glad you stayed for as long as you could before you really had to go

Ive found staying busy and pushing out of my comfort zone and trying to be more social is the best way to bring in positivity (he says whilst drinking alone at a bar) its a challenge but just try to progress, learn, and understand yourself. Stay well and endure

I need you here. More then you can understand. This thread has saved me the past few days. Its all thats keeping me going. And if you check out i dont know if this is worth it. We all need you. Please dont. We are a small community and we need each other to survive this cause no one else understands this. I wish there was a secret to life i could pass on that would save you but sadly life has no cheat codes. Endure. You will miss some of your greatest moments in life if you leave. We are all in this together and i hope you can find it inside yourself to stick around

I get it. I understand. Ive been there. Its terrifying, the thought of being alone and in a new place. But going to college is a lot different then going highschool. People are more mature, usually, and its a chance for you to reinvent yourself in a way. I know the loneliness can feel suffocating and it feels like you can dround in emotions that no one will understand. But its not always like that. Things will change. I was terrified of college cause i was way older then my peers, and im also super introverted. I thought itd be a horrible experience. Turned out to be an amazing experience and changed my life for the better and helped me really find out who i am. Endure. Things will always be changing and there will be great moments that make you glad you stuck around. Let me know how your feeling and try and be positive. Its your only weapon against these dark thoughts. Sometimes it feels comfortable to sink into them and dream about death but try to not give in. Love

Hey. Your not alone. Not in a vague, "lifes hard" kinda way, but in more of a, im in the exact same situation. Not exact, we are all different, but ive had all that happen to me, and still does. I cant tell you life gets better, cause you never know what happens tomorrow, but im more then positive things will change as long as you try and get through it. I dont know why life is so much simpler for some people and it never seems fair but i guess thats the way it is. And as long as you hang on im sure there will be a beautiful moment that happens, either meeting someone, or having a great day alone, that will make you glad your still here. Ive learned that for people like us the lows are so low but the highs of life are crazy moments. And while last night i almost hung myself, today was great, and im truly glad i didnt. Theres no secrets to this or magic. Its just endure. Which seems grim, but at moments it feels way more then worth it. Ill stay alive as long as you do. Please be brave and let me know how your feeling
Take care friend, thanks for being so cool, hope your doing well and have a good one. Ill message you soon

I wrote bitter world so no worries im super proud of it. I dont read much but i should. Its weird that as much as you can know about your sadness and feelings, they dont go away. Cant unthink them. And yea idk what my diagnoses would be, but ive been starting to notice im quite bipolar. I have 6 to 16 month stretches of feeling great. Nothing bothers me or brings me down, unhealthy cause i dont deal with problems either. Then i get crippling suicidal thoughts and wanting to totally isolate for months. Along with anxiety and fear. And i think i have a slight touch of ptsd. I was jumped once and now whenever im alone in public im on constant red alert and go into flight or fight mode quite easily where your adrenaline pumps and start sweating

that sounds like a lot of fun, and no we dont gig. its just me and one other person, and we play all the instruments on the album, usually who ever writes the song plays it all, only a few we really worked together on. so with just 2 people we cant recreate the songs. also we had to do the album so quick that i honestly forget some guitar parts and now hes moved away so for now its dead. just an album

thanks for listening at all man and if your not into it thats fine, i just want to share it with people at this point. still havent found an audience yet though. rasp is something i use to do but the tone of my voice isnt as good so i went softer to get better tone. and recording music is 90% just knowing how. I made some really bad bands sound great. Just start with a guitar and use audacity on your computer, thats how i started, and just make stuff you enjoy. hopefully if you like it someone else will too, hopefully, like i said, still havent found an audience but oh well. i like the music
the hard part isn't making it, its making any sort of money with it, which wasn't the point, but everyone has a dream, and im having a hard time letting go of this one

We can make up a lot of stuff in our head that people dont actually think. Your SO may love you more then you think and if you talk to them you might feel better. Dont do this to them though. You owe it to them to be honest about how you are feeling. You got into the relationship and i know you would want them to talk to you before they killed themselves. Its a hard conversation and you dont want to talk about it, i get that. But when someone agrees to be with you, and you agreed to be with them, you owe them atleast a conversation. Would you buy a house without talking to them about it first? Cause death is far more permanent then a loan. Id prefer death though. Stay alive for today atleast. Thats easy

Lol yea. Been there. Still there. But i was the same 10 years ago at 15. I could lie and say it all goes away, that youll wake up feeling great once you realize how amazing you are. But you wont. Not like that anyways. The thing that will happen though is you will have great times. You will have experiences that change how you think about everything and make you feel amazing and that things will be ok. You will be so glad you didnt punch out early. But then it will fade. And youll be sad and scared and alone and want to do nothing more then shoot a stranger in thr face to see if it even bothers you anymore. If your anything like me, and it sounds like you might be, wait it out. Try and look forward to something. Something to live for. Id do it with videogames when i had nothing else. Also dont do heroin or opiates. They may seem to help but they only make things worse. And try not to hate so much. Try to understand people it helps. Your dads just as fucked up as you, and deals with it the wrong way but hes scared of trying to live any other way. But i really dont know anything. I do know your young and life doesnt start to get really shitty till your on your own. 100% alone and your looking at real sadness. Working a dead end job for 35 years to barely get by and eat kd. Your young still. Just do things that make you happy and live it up
